senses.example: Du skal holde dig i ro, mens lægen undersøger dit ben.
senses.example_translation: You must stay still while the doctor examines your leg.

senses.example: Efter operationen skal du holde dig i ro i et par dage.
senses.example_translation: After the operation, you must take it easy for a few days.

senses.example: Jeg prøver at afholde mig fra slik i hverdagene.
senses.example_translation: I try to refrain from sweets on weekdays.

senses.example: Jeg fik besked om at vente udenfor.
senses.example_translation: I was told to wait outside.

senses.example: De byder velkommen ved døren.
senses.example_translation: They welcome guests at the door.

senses.example: Kagen smager af citron.
senses.example_translation: The cake tastes of lemon.

senses.text: to pass away (peacefully, in one's sleep)
senses.example: Min gamle nabo sov ind i nat.
senses.example_translation: My old neighbor passed away last night.

senses.example: Jeg sov ud i morges.
senses.example_translation: I slept in this morning.

senses.example: Han kastede et blik på uret.
senses.example_translation: He glanced at the clock.

senses.example: Han kastede et blik på uret og skyndte sig videre.
senses.example_translation: He glanced at the clock and hurried on.

senses.example: Hun modsætter sig altid nye regler på arbejdet.
senses.example_translation: She always opposes new rules at work.

senses.example: Han bad børnene holde mund under filmen.
senses.example_translation: He asked the children to keep quiet during the film.

senses.example: Jeg sov som en sten hele natten.
senses.example_translation: I slept like a log all night.

senses.example: Hendes nye kjole tiltrækker sig meget opmærksomhed.
senses.example_translation: Her new dress attracts a lot of attention.

senses.example: Kan du gøre mig en stor tjeneste og hente børnene i dag?
senses.example_translation: Can you do me a big favor and pick up the kids today?

senses.example: Min bror gør tjeneste i hæren lige nu.
senses.example_translation: My brother is serving in the army right now.

senses.example: Den gamle sofa gør tjeneste som seng.
senses.example_translation: The old sofa serves as a bed.

senses.example: De andre børn gjorde grin med hans nye frisure.
senses.example_translation: The other children made fun of his new hairstyle.

senses.example: Tågen sænkede sig langsomt over marken.
senses.example_translation: The fog slowly descended over the field.

senses.example: Hun strider med lektierne hver aften.
senses.example_translation: She struggles with her homework every evening.

senses.example: Samtalen kredsede om vejret hele aftenen.
senses.example_translation: The conversation revolved around the weather all evening.

senses.example: Månen kredser rundt om jorden hele tiden.
senses.example_translation: The moon revolves around the earth all the time.

senses.example: Jeg er fan af den nye film.
senses.example_translation: I'm a fan of the new movie.

senses.example: Han skruer op for musikken om aftenen.
senses.example_translation: He turns up the music in the evening.

senses.example: Hun skruer op for musikken i stuen.
senses.example_translation: She turns up the music in the living room.

senses.example: Du skal betale forud for opholdet.
senses.example_translation: You must pay in advance for the stay.

senses.example: Han bøder på sin manglende erfaring med hårdt arbejde.
senses.example_translation: He makes up for his lack of experience with hard work.

senses.example: Vi grinede os halvt ihjel over den sjove film.
senses.example_translation: We laughed our heads off at the funny film.

senses.example: Vi råder over tre mødelokaler på kontoret.
senses.example_translation: We have three meeting rooms at our disposal in the office.

senses.example: Han spiller falsk når vi spiller kort.
senses.example_translation: He cheats when we play cards.

senses.example: Hun synger falsk hver gang hun prøver.
senses.example_translation: She sings out of tune every time she tries.

senses.example: Vi skal tage i betragtning, at priserne er steget.
senses.example_translation: We must take into account that prices have increased.

senses.example: Bussen standser ved stationen hver morgen.
senses.example_translation: The bus stops at the station every morning.

senses.example: Hun beklager sig altid over vejret.
senses.example_translation: She always complains about the weather.

senses.example: Dyret tilpasser sig langsomt det nye miljø.
senses.example_translation: The animal slowly adapts to the new environment.

senses.example: Hun har en affære med sin kollega.
senses.example_translation: She is having an affair with her colleague.

senses.example: Han er arbejdsløs lige nu.
senses.example_translation: He is unemployed right now.

senses.example: Jeg forsikrer mig om, at døren er låst, inden jeg går i seng.
senses.example_translation: I make sure the door is locked before I go to bed.

senses.example: Byggeriet skrider frem efter planen.
senses.example_translation: Construction is progressing according to plan.

senses.example: Jeg dyrker motion hver morgen før arbejde.
senses.example_translation: I exercise every morning before work.

senses.text: to have a cosy, pleasant time together
senses.example: Vi hygger os altid med et glas vin om aftenen.
senses.example_translation: We always have a cosy time together with a glass of wine in the evening.

senses.text: to sink down (into liquid or a soft substance)
senses.example: Stenen synker ned i vandet.
senses.example_translation: The stone sinks into the water.

senses.example: Hunden rendte væk, da den så katten.
senses.example_translation: The dog ran away when it saw the cat.

senses.example: Jeg smutter forbi bageren på vej hjem.
senses.example_translation: I drop by the bakery on my way home.

senses.example: Hun klædte sig ud som en pirat til fastelavn.
senses.example_translation: She dressed up as a pirate for Carnival.
